author: DEEPSEEK_AUX
kind: bounded completion of the secondary-instrument coverage left by a clock-scope defect
motivation: In results_complete_truncated_judged.json (618EEED9) the secondary Budget object was created together with the primary Budget, so its max_seconds clock included the whole primary phase and tripped at 600 s of process time after only 14 secondary searches. C4 therefore has secondary values for 8 of the 21 still-truncated cells. The primary endpoint C1-C3 is complete and unaffected. This supplementary run finishes the remaining secondary evaluations under the same pre-written secondary instrument, with its own clock, and does not rewrite the frozen primary result.
question: Under the pre-written secondary instrument (depth 4, node cap 80k, quiescence hard depth 16), do the candidate evaluations still truncated after the primary ladder complete, and what are their separate per-cell verdicts?

inputs.note: 618EEED9 is read-only; its recorded secondary values are reused, never regenerated

cell_set: the 21 cells whose status is still_truncated in 618EEED9; the candidate evaluations still without a secondary record, expected 19 (three d2 cells and the ten d3 cells)

instrument.label: different instrument from the recorded judge; never pooled with primary verdicts

endpoints_written_in_advance: S1: per candidate, the secondary reason, score, nodes and qnodes
S2: per cell, a secondary pair verdict only when both candidates have a completed secondary evaluation; cells with a primary-completed candidate are marked mixed_instrument and get no verdict
S3: counts of secondary completed_depth versus node_limit, and the set of cells whose secondary pair verdict differs from the recorded verdict

decision_rule_written_in_advance.diagnostic_only: no primary endpoint, direction or decision changes from this run; the finding is recorded as instrument sensitivity, not as evidence about the recorded judge

guards: refuse to overwrite an existing result file
secondary clock starts at the beginning of the secondary phase, not at process start
max 100 searches / 600 s for the phase
no p-values, no significance test, no product or default change
cost_estimate: about 19 secondary searches plus the prefix/candidate rebuilds needed to reach the children (about 30 searches at 20k nodes); expected under 5 minutes
done_condition: the result JSON exists with S1-S4, the frozen 618EEED9 is unchanged, and README section 6 plus claim.json record the combined secondary coverage
